answer: Vine vouching: each fake identity needs 3 real sponsors, and a sponsor may vouch only once per 8 epochs, so 1,000 fakes cost 24,000 sponsor-epochs. The vine is the vouch graph. During a newcomer's first voyage (4 epochs), auditors launch random walks from it, with start points drawn from yarrow, a fresh per-epoch seed. If most walks loop back into a tight cluster that barely touches the rest of the vine, it fails and its sponsors' stakes are slashed. Farms can't pre-shape a graph for an unknown seed or bulk-buy rate-limited vouches. Limit: slower onboarding.
